Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.seeding

Class SeedContext

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.seeding.SeedContext
public final class SeedContext extends Object
What a Seeder reads and writes through during one run.

The connection, query factory and schema are bound to the run: in a transaction run they are the transaction's, and every seeder called from here receives the same ones. A context is used by one thread, the thread that runs the seeders; it is not thread-safe.

    • callOnce

      @SafeVarargs public final SeedContext callOnce(Supplier<? extends Seeder>... seeders)
      Runs seeders that have not run yet in this run.

      A seeder counts as run once any call variant started it. The record lasts for one DatabaseManager.seed call, so the next run starts empty.

      Parameters:
      seeders - creates each seeder, never null, without null elements
      Returns:
      this context
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null, or a supplier returns null
      IllegalStateException - if a seeder is already running through a plain call
